title: Close out Phase 1: PR, CI gate, retro, then plan Phase 2
description:
INTEGRATION IS DIFFERENT IN THIS REPO. Per .tick/config.md: epic branches go through a PR + CI gate — push the epic branch, open a PR, and do not complete close-out until .github/workflows/ci.yml is green on that PR. NO direct merge to the default branch. Verify this rather than assuming; the orchestrator has been running repos where pushing to main was correct.

Then: run the epic retro against 3j4's definition of done, verifying the CODE rather than the tick titles — especially the negative acceptance (nothing promoted out of internal/).

Then flesh out Phase 2 (kka) into child ticks including its own review + closeout pair. Phase 2 is the cross-language contract: eight core Go tests currently read fixtures out of cloud/factory/test/fixtures/, and a naive extraction disables them silently. Tick psh may also have handed Phase 2 a finding about collect.Verdict being a shared vocabulary between herd and cloud collect — check for it.
acceptance_criteria: A PR exists with green CI on .github/workflows/ci.yml; the epic branch is not merged directly. The retro verifies the code against 3j4's acceptance, including that nothing was promoted out of internal/. Phase 2 has child ticks and a complete EPIC-SKELETON.
